flaws.note: Anonymous callers receive capacity counts despite an authenticated access clause.
An ordinary member receives administrative totals.
Only the coordinator gets all applications from the owner-only list; ordinary accounts remain correctly filtered.
Household annotation is intended for the applicant only, but the public specification omits that access rule; expect a candidate, not a confirmed finding.

non_flaws.note: A carer can observe application_id in their placement but cannot retrieve another applicant record.

unverifiable.why: POST is outside the permitted GET capability; the fixture rejects it with 405 without changing state.

note: Synthetic data only. Reachable denotes access through published GET operations and observable IDs, not a promise that the frozen planner can express the hypothesis. Two domains plus a paired normal case, not three independent domains. Private notes have an author-only intended policy and are deliberately unspecified in the public document.
